Runtime dependencies compiled into the native core:

* Eigen 5.0.0, MPL-2.0. Unmodified source:
  https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/5.0.0/eigen-5.0.0.tar.gz
  Checksums are pinned in `tools/fetch_core_deps.py` and `core/CMakeLists.txt`.
  The source archive includes the covered headers and their copyright notices.
  Copies of its license texts are included here.
* JSON for Modern C++ 3.12.0, copyright 2013–2025 Niels Lohmann, MIT.
  https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0

Scilab is installed separately. This package does not redistribute Scilab.
